summary.text: David Gallegos is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 41 in Eddy and Lea counties.
The legislature's member page lists Gallegos as a representative from 2013 to 2020, and as a member of the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee and the Senate Rules Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Gallegos's occupation as senior superintendent and a district office in Hobbs.
Between sessions, Gallegos is a member of the Legislative Council, the Land Grant Committee and the Radioactive and Hazardous Materials Committee.
